answer: Each agent must stake a unique pearl token locked to a hardware-attested identity, and every epoch it submits a plume signature derived from its private key plus the current atlas merkle root. Duplicate keys collapse to one stake, so running N sybils costs N full stakes while earning rewards for only one. Faking the plume requires breaking the attested enclave, and replaying an old atlas root is rejected instantly. Honest agents pay one stake; adversaries pay N times more to gain nothing.
